questions.question: Which National Hockey League team made history by recording a natural hat trick in three consecutive fixtures?
questions.explanation: The Florida Panthers established a new league milestone by achieving natural hat tricks in three back-to-back games.
questions.context: 2026–27 NHL season: In ice hockey, the Florida Panthers become the first team in the National Hockey League to record a natural hat trick in three consecutive games.

readMore.publisher: The Athletic via The New York Times

questions.question: Which prominent protest movement joined student demonstrations across France to rally against rising fuel costs?
questions.explanation: Members of the Yellow vests movement held major rallies over escalating fuel expenses, teaming up with protesting students.
questions.context: 2026 French fuel protests: Yellow vests activists hold mass demonstrations across France against rising fuel prices and join the student protests.

questions.question: Demonstrations dubbed the 'No Kings' protests were held across the United States opposing which political figure?
questions.explanation: The demonstrations targeted Donald Trump and his administration while encouraging voter turnout before midterm elections.
questions.context: Protests against Donald Trump: The fourth round of No Kings protests are held across the United States against president Donald Trump and his administration and to encourage early voting ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.

questions.question: Which country's president recently offered full military and defensive support to Saudi Arabia if requested?
questions.explanation: President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi pledged that Egypt stands ready to take necessary actions to assist and defend Saudi Arabia.
questions.context: Egypt–Saudi Arabia relations, Houthi–Saudi conflict: Egyptian president Abdel Fattah El-Sisi states that Egypt will take all necessary steps to protect and defend Saudi Arabia should the latter so desire.

questions.question: Health officials in which East African country recently confirmed an increase in cases of Bundibugyo ebolavirus?
questions.explanation: Kenya reported four newly confirmed infections among healthcare workers and a relative, bringing the country's case count to seven.
questions.context: 2026 Ebola epidemic: Kenya confirms four additional cases of Bundibugyo ebolavirus, including three health workers who treated Kenya's first patient and one of his relatives, raising the national total to seven. All four are already in quarantine.
